gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and businesslike, with tall lowercase bodies and crisp crossbars as thick as the stems. And Ethnocentric stretches out above it, fast and aggressive, its wide tracking pushing every letter apart.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-inter-tight:
Inter Tight reads like bent tubing, its short ascenders barely clearing the lowercase.

Ethnocentric is the one that sprints, spaced wide and aggressive, while Inter Tight simply holds the line with sober, even strokes of uniform weight.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-kufam: Ethnocentric spaces its letters far apart, so every big bowl gets room to roll. Kufam follows in a plain sans of single-width strokes, its open e curves and dominant bodies keeping paragraphs smooth and legible.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-lexend-deca: Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart with positive tracking, fast and aggressive above big bowls and short ascenders, while Lexend Deca waits below. Fast meets friendly.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-liter: Sharp, fast and wide, Ethnocentric spreads its big bowls across the line while Liter stands tall and plain beneath it. Speed above, steadiness below.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mochiy-pop-p-: Ethnocentric drives hard with short ascenders over big bowls and wide tracking. Mochiy Pop P One brings the strongest quality here: a sizable, approachable sans-serif lowercase with generous space between each letter.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mozilla-headl: Approachable is the mood Mozilla Headline sets, with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal beneath Ethnocentric's fast, aggressive capitals. And over many lines that plain sans stays friendly and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mozilla-text: Professional is the mood of Mozilla Text, whose tall lowercase bodies look bold and whose terminals flare outward under Ethnocentric's fast, aggressive display letters. It reads steadily.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-nokora: Nokora reads as a thick, dark stripe of lowercase with a wide-open s, approachable under Ethnocentric's fast heading. Page after page it stays inviting.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans: Ethnocentric opens fast and aggressive, with wide tracking and big bowls, above Noto Sans, whose tall lowercase and open c invite easy reading. Smooth going.
